mission.title: Disrupted Connection
mission.description: Track the General's key to Silver, take it from him and get it to a Zion drop site.

npc.say: We'll put in a good word for you with Niobe.

phase.briefing:
{player}, as you know, the Machines have been tracking the General's missing key to a separate construct. But we've picked up a burst of Machine activity in the Matrix lately, and Commander Lock thinks it may indicate a new development in the key's status.
Zion must learn whatever the Machines have found out about the key. Fortunately, we know of a group of Cypherites who maintain secret, well-placed Machine contacts. These Cypherites have probably already obtained the latest Machine intelligence on the key. Conduct a strike on this Cypherite group, and search their facility for any new data pertaining to the missing key.

enter.say: I've got redpill signals in there. Should be our Cypherite targets.

objective.text: Search the computer for data on the key

done.say: Ooh, juicy. Upload that data to me at a hardline.

objective.text: Upload the Data at a hardline

phase.briefing:
Warrior, the data you retrieved indicates that the Machines have picked up the key's code signature back inside the Matrix. If the intelligence you recovered recently from the Frenchman's operatives was correct, our best guess is that the Exile known as Silver is in control of the key. He may have brought it back into the Matrix for an exchange with the Merovingian.
Silver operates primarily in Camon Heights. We've got the location of one of his hit squads in that neighborhood. Hit them, and try to ascertain Silver's current whereabouts.

enter.say: I've got Exile programs in there; the signals fit the profile for Silver's goons.

objective.text: Get the access disk from Nightmare

done.say: An access disk. Could get you past the security on one of the computers around there.

objective.text: Use the access disk on the computer

done.say: Nice; you have access to that system now. Try searching their network.
Good thinking. An admin machine called "punishment," huh? I'm betting that's our twisted Mr. Silver's box. Running a coord trace on it now. Get on the street and we'll confer with Tyndall.

phase.briefing:
Excellent work, {player}! We've scanned the location of that network address and found a concentration of powerful programs. Silver may be one of them.
This strike is of paramount importance to Zion, so you'll have a commando squad at your disposal. I'm directing you to the squad's location now.

enter.say: Your squad's in there. I say make these guys take point.

talk.say: The offending programs will be deleted, sir.
Shouldn't be a problem, sir. We've dealt with this kind of target before.

objective.text: Lead Marano, Wong and Kissel out of the area

phase.briefing: All right, Warrior, you've got the target location. Secure the area as quickly as possible, and search the place thoroughly for the key. This could be it!

enter.say: I'm picking up some heavy programs in there. You've got those commandos with you, right?

done.say: That's all of Silver's goons in the vicinity. Now let's see if the man himself will be a little more open to friendly negotiations.
My orders are to remain on guard at this location, sir.

talk.say:
I seem to have run out of guards. Very well, you get the key...for now.
Look, if you want it, take it. I don't have all day to stand around talking with meat.

done.say: That's it! Bring it outside. I'll get Tyndall on the horn.
I suggest you make yourself scarce, meatbag. My associates will be coming for that key.

phase.briefing: Warrior, I'm marking out the location of our nearest secure drop site. Get the key there, fast! Reports indicate that hostiles are converging on your location.

enter.say: That's the drop site. Both Zion and the General's troops have the place locked down tight. You're supposed to make the hand-off to a Zion officer in there by the name of Andersen.

talk.say: You've got the key? Good. I'll take it off your hands. We'll have it under heavy guard 24-7 until we can get it to Niobe.

done.say: Thanks, operative. We'll take it from here. You've been a great help.

mission.finish:
Great work today, {player}. Thanks to you, the key is back in our hands. Zion rests easier knowing you're on the job.
But we must remain vigilant. The Merovingian is sure to try to get the key back once he finds out that we took it from Silver, and even the Machines might make some sort of play for it. Stay on your toes, Warrior. I'll be in touch.
